svg.desc: Local Economic Development (LED) Projects LOCATION Fayoum - Beni-Suef - Luxor - Aswan Governorates Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Local Development STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 26.5 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Project Overview Designing and supervising the implementation of local development projects in four governorates: Fayoum, Beni Suef, Luxor, and Aswan. This project aims to support the Ministry of Local Development in establishing a modern and decentralized local administration system at the central and local levels in selected governorates, committed to good governance, and aims to support and promote integrated local development by promoting excellence in the delivery of local public services, and promoting local economic and social development.
